unresolvedGroups.question: Which target-specific printed anatomy regions and exact coordinate boundaries are governed for the unresolved QT faces?
Which exact bull/ring coordinate maps and printed values are governed for QT-only bullseye faces?
Which QT-only B-family variants have governed ring values and exact registered geometry beyond proven exact surfaces?
Which exact A/C/D or competition-region boundaries and values apply to the QT-only faces?
What are the exact DIAG-L/R sector boundaries and publisher feedback labels for each handedness?
What exact object coordinate map is governed, and which cue/order/score semantics—if any—are published?
Is any executable region, object, score, diagnostic, or qualification semantic published beyond evidence and total taps?
What exact figure boundaries and penalty/no-shoot semantics are governed for each QT composition?
Which existing M16/M4 contract is an exact face match, and what qualification versus zeroing mode applies?
What exact per-object coordinate map is governed for each QT-only repeated-object face?
What exact QT region boundaries, values, and course aggregation are governed for each unresolved qualification face?
Which QT sight-in faces have an exact governed aim/impact geometry and zeroing contract rather than only visible bulls?

crossFamilyObservations: Exact prior-surface identity is sufficient to inherit approved target-specific geometry and behavior.
Behavior-family recognition alone is not sufficient to invent a QT coordinate map, point value, diagnostic label, or course rule.
Generic family geometry was the dominant cross-family defect; unresolved QT-only faces now fail closed without discarding identity or tap evidence.
